info.name: STARYATUBE · CHERRY CHROME
info.description: A bold Y2K-inspired YouTube theme blending chocolate brown, cherry red, soft pink and deep black with glossy chrome details. Featuring immersive dark surfaces, rounded thumbnails, metallic accents, dreamy gradients and smooth transitions. A nostalgic cyber-retro aesthetic with a polished, experimental edge.
info.additionalInfo:
Version 1.0 · Initial release

An experimental Y2K-inspired YouTube theme featuring chocolate brown, cherry red, soft pink and deep black. Includes rounded thumbnails, custom interface accents, smooth hover transitions and a coordinated dark palette.
